description: Wandering night monsters check script, seed 1, one player: the debug tools mark the land within 200 m of the Big House explored at step 2; at step 3600, late in the first dusk, the three starting warriors (units 5 to 7) walk 90 m east into the explored wild, out of reach of the town's claimed land and lights, and stand there through night 0 while the waves go for the town. The wild's patches round them fill with night 0's kinds (giant rats, cave bats, zombies, slimes) out of their sight, at least 35 m off; the wanderers stroll, and those that come within their 2 s run (3 m at least) go for the warriors. At step 8200, in the dawn, the warriors walk home; every wanderer has burned or fled by then. Columns are 45 cm, heights terrain units (11.25 cm); moves are world units (8,000 per metre); ids as of M11: workers are units 1 to 4, warriors 5 to 7.
